column1: # Resident Evil 4 (Switch 2): update v131072, SDK 21.4.3 (Ounce), NVN2; Capcom's RE Engine with Havok and Wwise. See README.md
# the display version is not in the dump; the update's version stands in for it
# not loaded, main takes nothing from them the host does not supply: subsdk0 (C / libc), subsdk1 (NintendoSDK_DLSS); subsdk2 is NintendoSDK_movie
# the Switch 2's 9 GB pool; main sets a heap (a 5 GB block with a large alias region)
# the NPDM declares 20 MB of system resource, so virtual address memory is on
# RE Engine: the shaders are SDF definitions inside the KPKA PAKs (shader_split.py kpka_jobs / sdf_shaders), in a third layout (0x60-byte stage record headers)
# the game calls nvnDeviceSetDepthMode with near = 0 (the host log: depth mode near=0)
